description.value: Chez Christophe is a Swiss-inspired chocolaterie and patisserie founded in 2013 by Swiss-trained pastry chef Christophe Bonzon, operating its original flagship in Burnaby Heights on Hastings Street. The café serves espresso beverages made with locally roasted beans from Pallet Coffee Roasters alongside freshly baked croissants, cakes, tarts, macarons, and handcrafted artisan chocolates. A touring cyclist passing through Burnaby Heights will find it a high-quality stop for a specialty coffee and house-made pastry.
